title: Britecharts stackedArea spec
description: A stackedArea chart: the chart's name, its configuration (the accessors, commands and events the stackedArea wrapper takes) and its data.

a11yDataTable.description: Gets or Sets whether the chart renders its data as a table that screen readers can read, row by row and cell by cell. The table is visually hidden, placed right after the svg and linked from it with `aria-details`; its caption is the chart's name. On by default: set it to false for an app that gives the data its own accessible form.

a11yDescription.description: Gets or Sets a longer description screen readers announce after the name, such as what the data shows. It is rendered as the svg's `<desc>` and linked with `aria-describedby`. Unset, there is no description.

a11yKeyboardNavigation.description: Gets or Sets whether a keyboard can move through the chart's data points. The chart takes one tab stop; the arrow keys move between points, Home and End go to the first and last, and Escape lets go. The tooltip, highlights and custom events follow focus as they follow the pointer. On by default.

a11yTitle.description: Gets or Sets the name screen readers announce for the chart. It is set as the svg's `aria-label`. Unset, the getter reads `null` and the chart is announced by its type, such as "Bar chart".

animationDuration.description: Gets or Sets the duration of the animation

areaCurve.description: Gets or Sets the area curve of the stacked area.

areaOpacity.description: Gets or Sets the opacity of the stacked areas in the chart (all of them will have the same opacity)

axisTimeCombinations.description: Exposes the constants to be used to force the x axis to respect a certain granularity current options: MINUTE_HOUR, HOUR_DAY, DAY_MONTH, MONTH_YEAR

colorMap.description: Gets or Sets the colorMap of the chart.

colorSchema.description: Gets or Sets the colorSchema of the chart

customBrushEnd.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customBrushStart.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customClick.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseMove.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseOut.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

customMouseOver.$comment: A function: set it from JavaScript, since JSON can't hold one.

emptyDataConfig.description: Gets or Sets the emptyDataConfig of the chart

exportChart.description: Executes a command that triggers the download of the current chart: an svg file when the filename ends in `.svg`, and a png otherwise

grid.description: Gets or Sets the grid mode

hasOutline.description: Enables or disables the outline at the top of the areas

height.description: Gets or Sets the height of the chart

isAnimated.description: Gets or Sets the isAnimated property of the chart, making it to animate when render. Ignored when the reader's system asks for reduced motion

isLoading.description: Gets or Sets the loading state of the chart

isNormalized.description: Gets or Sets whether the areas fill the whole value axis, a 100% stacked area chart: each area shows its share of each date's total, and the value axis runs from 0% to 100%. The tooltip still shows the values. Meant for data without negative values.

locale.description: Pass language tag for the tooltip to localize the date. Uses Intl.DateTimeFormat, for compatability and support, refer to https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/DateTimeFormat

margin.description: Gets or Sets the margin object of the chart (top, bottom, left and right)

numberFormat.description: Gets or Sets the number format of the chart. Null until one is set, where the shared declaration promises a string: this chart has no default format.

tooltipThreshold.description: Gets or Sets the minimum width of the graph in order to show the tooltip

topicsOrder.description: Pass an override for the ordering of the topics

width.description: Gets or Sets the width of the chart

xAxisCustomFormat.description: Exposes the ability to force the chart to show a certain x format It requires a `xAxisFormat` of 'custom' in order to work. NOTE: localization not supported Accepts the format for x axis, one of the d3.js date formats [here]{@link https://github.com/d3/d3-time-format#locale_format}

xAxisFormat.description: Exposes the ability to force the chart to show a certain x axis grouping It is a combination of axisTimeCombinations (MINUTE_HOUR, HOUR_DAY, DAY_MONTH, MONTH_YEAR) Set it to 'custom' to make use of specific formats with xAxisCustomFormat *

xAxisScale.description: Gets or Sets the `xAxisScale`. Choose between 'linear' and 'logarithmic'. The setting will only work if `xAxisValueType` is set to 'number' as well, otherwise it won't influence the visualization.

xAxisValueType.description: Gets or Sets the `xAxisValueType`. Choose between 'date' and 'number'. When set to `number` the values of the x-axis must not be dates anymore, but can be arbitrary numbers.

xTicks.description: Exposes the ability to force the chart to show a certain x ticks. It requires a `xAxisFormat` of 'custom' in order to work. NOTE: This value needs to be a multiple of 2, 5 or 10. They won't always work as expected, as D3 decides at the end how many and where the ticks will appear.

yAxisBaseline.description: Gets or Sets the yAxisBaseline - this is the y-value where the area starts from in y-direction (default is 0). Change this value if you don't want to start your area from y=0.

yAxisLabel.description: Gets or Sets the y-axis label of the chart

yAxisLabelOffset.description: Gets or Sets the offset of the yAxisLabel of the chart. The method accepts both positive and negative values.

yTicks.description: Gets or Sets the number of ticks of the y axis on the chart
